cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:f6.title: Service Shop Lead Technician - Heavy Duty Vehicles
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:f6.description: Our client is a family-owned and operated truck and trailer repair shop specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance, with a focus on the car hauling industry. They are fully equipped to handle all aspects of heavy-duty repair, offering top-tier diagnostic tools and a professional, supportive work environment. Our client is seeking a qualified Heavy-Duty Diesel Service Shop Lead to lead operations at a satellite repair facility specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance. This role requires a hands-on leader with the ability to diagnose required repairs and assist technicians in completing service orders while ensuring efficient shop operations. The facility consists of a two-bay shop that operates with a team of two technicians and a manager when fully staffed. The shop primarily services front-loaded cement mixers and tri-axle dump trucks, while also handling a wide range of heavy-duty repair work across the commercial truck industry.
responsibilities: Manage day-to-day operations of the satellite shop location and maintain a fully staffed team of two active technicians.
Provide hands-on leadership by diagnosing repair needs and assisting technicians with the completion of service orders when necessary.
Coordinate the daily shop schedule and workflow to ensure efficient service operations.
Monitor technician productivity and shop performance to meet company benchmarks for labor hours and billed service time.
Maintain quality control standards and ensure all work meets company and industry expectations.
Utilize OEM diagnostic platforms and industry-standard tools, including Cummins and PACCAR diagnostic systems, as well as Snap-on, JPRO, and other required diagnostic equipment.
Manage shop inventory levels and maintain organization of tools and equipment.
Order special-order parts as required to complete service orders and maintain workflow.
Communicate regularly with company leadership regarding shop performance, operational updates, and improvement opportunities.
qualifications: Valid Class A driver’s license (Preferred)
Previous experience in heavy-duty diesel repair, with the ability to diagnose and assist with complex mechanical and electrical issues.
Prior leadership or shop management experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of heavy-duty truck diagnostics, including experience with OEM diagnostic software such as Cummins and PACCAR systems.
Familiarity with industry diagnostic platforms such as Snap-on, JPRO, or equivalent tools.
Ability to manage workflow, technicians, and shop productivity in a fast-paced service environment.
Strong organizational and communication skills.
Valid driver’s license required.
Ability to consistently arrive on time and maintain a reliable work schedule.
Willingness to work a standard schedule of approximately 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM, with flexibility as operational needs require.
Must be able to pass random and incident-based drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policies.

distro-distro:lever:4c03635e-6615-45c4-a.title: Crew Supervisor
distro-distro:lever:4c03635e-6615-45c4-a.description: Position Summary Responsible for the day-to-day work of his/her crew, including: its work schedule, job assignments, plants and materials, equipment and power tools, cost effectiveness, work quality, training and safety. Ensures that all assignments are implemented and completed. Sets example for all crew members. Oversees safe loading and driving of vehicle. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Supervise assigned laborers and ensure their compliance with all work orders, company policies, regulations, and work assignments. Ensure crew readiness for each daily work assignment, including crew preparation, truck, trailer, and motorized equipment operation, power and hand tools, job materials. Arrive at work ready and fully prepared to leave the shop promptly at assigned time. Ensures safe and legal and proper loading, unloading and driving of trucks Cultivate and maintain positive attitude and pro-active work style. Motivate and work with assigned crewmembers as a team, build and maintain an atmosphere of company-wide morale. Complete all assigned tasks and daily work orders as directed Works with crew to ensure the timely, safe and cost-effective completion of all assignments. Ensure that work meets or exceeds all company standards and is in compliance with company policies and procedures. Uses good judgment to take initiative in correcting problems that may occur. Attends classes and seminars to develop leadership and technical skills and training. Specific Responsibilities: Follow daily work orders from Division Manager or Supervisor, and confirm a thorough understanding of all assignments. Secure, organize and safely transport all equipment, tools, and materials required for each job. Work with laborers loading and off-loading all equipment, tools, and materials from vehicles to ensuring safe off-loading, safe staging, use and storage of all items at a client's property and in JSLI yard. Understand and operate all equipment and tools safely and in accordance with manufacturers operating instructions. Wear all personal protective clothing and equipment as required by company and in accordance with OSHA standards. Report work progress, problems and needs to the appropriate supervisor throughout the day. Report safety hazards on the job site to Division Manager or Supervisor. Report personnel problems to the appropriate supervisor in a timely fashion. Reports vehicle, equipment, tool maintenance and repair needs to the appropriate supervisor in a timely fashion. Interact with client on a regular basis as requested Respond to all communications from JSLI management in a timely manner. Ensure that each jobsite is left clean when crew departs... Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong preference for candidates with landscaping experience Must be hands-on and work alongside the crew Bilingual is a plus Competitive wages for the region Trucks equipped with on‐board restrooms Stable, full-year employment Strong leadership development environment Education & Experience Minimum 2 years prior work in industry Willingness to learn English MUST have clean driving record MUST have supervisory / leadership experience #HireFinder #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Onsite

emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:e638823b-ba4.title: Staff Accountant
emergence-emergence:ashbyhq:e638823b-ba4.description: Staff Accountant, Emergence | Remote - India | Full-Time Who We Are Emergence is a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. We invest in focused portfolios with specialized operating groups that combine operational rigor with a growth equity mindset. Our model requires consolidated financial reporting across multiple portfolio companies, and we prioritize accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness in every close cycle. The Mission Own accurate, timely monthly and annual financial closes across consolidation entities while maintaining U.S. GAAP compliance and audit-ready documentation. What You'll Do - Complete month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles on established calendars with zero material errors. - Prepare and post 50+ monthly journal entries with complete supporting documentation and GL reconciliation within 48 hours. - Reconcile 15+ balance sheet accounts monthly, investigate discrepancies, and maintain roll-forward schedules for accruals. - Maintain and reconcile bank accounts, AR/AP subledgers, and fixed asset registers to the general ledger. - Record fixed asset additions, disposals, transfers, and calculate monthly depreciation with zero variance tolerance. - Support internal and external audits by delivering organized, cross-referenced documentation within 48 hours of request. What We're Looking For Must-haves - Demonstrable mastery of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, and month-end close mechanics (CA, CMA, or 3+ years staff-level accounting). - Proficiency in ERP systems: Sage Intacct, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. - Advanced Excel skills: PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, nested formulas; ability to build reconciliation trackers independently. - Experience preparing journal entries and performing reconciliations in multi-entity or consolidation environments. - Demonstrated attention to detail with ability to catch errors before submission and maintain complete audit trails. Nice-to-haves - CA (Qualified) or CA Fresher credential. - Prior experience in a PE portfolio company or multi-entity consolidation environment. - Familiarity with Sage Intacct or NetSuite specifically. Who you are You take pride in catching your own errors before they reach anyone else. You build reconciliation controls and exception reports proactively, not reactively. When you encounter a bottleneck in the close process, you research solutions and propose specific improvements. You ask clarifying questions before assuming your approach is right. You credit teammates when complex work gets resolved. You refuse to post entries without complete supporting documentation. Your track record shows you consistently deliver audit-ready work on time. What We Offer - Salary: $10,000 USD annually. - Remote work based in India. - Exposure to PE-backed business scaling and consolidation accounting. - Opportunity to build accounting process infrastructure across multiple portfolio companies.

Working closely with sales and product teams, you will connect marketing execution with broader commercial and growth objectives. Contribute to content marketing, SEO/SEM and localisation initiatives where relevant to regional growth strategies. Requirements 3–5 years of marketing experience within Forex, CFD, Fintech, financial services or a closely related industry. Strong hands-on experience with paid advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta and TikTok. Proven experience managing social media channels and developing or coordinating digital content. Practical experience with affiliate, Introducing Broker and influencer marketing campaigns. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign KPIs and use performance insights to optimise marketing activities. Good understanding of digital acquisition, campaign optimisation and brand growth strategies. Excellent communication, organisation and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of campaigns from planning through execution and optimisation. Familiarity with SEO/SEM within the financial services sector is an advantage. Knowledge of financial marketing compliance requirements, including ESMA and FCA standards, is highly desirable. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager (Internal HRIS / HR Tech) based in France. This is a product leadership opportunity focused on building and evolving internal HR technology for a global, distributed organization. You will own product discovery, requirements, prioritization, and roadmap decisions across core HRIS capabilities, including Core HR and Time Off. Working closely with Design, AI-assisted Development, and business stakeholders, you will turn complex needs into clear, actionable product requirements. You will play a central role in improving B2B and administrative user experiences while ensuring secure, scalable, and intuitive workflows. Need a 3rd shift opportunity where you can support production, keep things moving, and make an impact each night? If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and take pride in doing quality work, this could be a great fit! Ditsch USA is looking for a Production Associate to join their Cincinnati team on 3rd shift . In this role, you will support production by packaging products, moving materials, and helping keep operations running safely and efficiently. If you enjoy hands-on work and being part of a strong team, this could be a solid opportunity. Starting pay: $18-$20/hour. Why Join Ditsch USA? Competitive starting pay ($18-$20/hour) 3rd shift schedule (10:00 PM - 6:00 AM) Medical, dental, and vision insurance Free $25,000 life insurance 401(k) with company match PTO and paid holidays Ongoing training and career development About the Role As a Production Associate , you will help keep production running smoothly by packaging products, supporting the production line, and maintaining quality and safety standards. Always follow safety guidelines and food manufacturing procedures. Handle materials using equipment such as pallet jacks. Support equipment checks and report any issues. What You Bring We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable Production Associate working in a fast-paced environment.
